details:
This is a massive suggestion, but will ultimately make the whole Main Menu more user friendly. 
I'll start with the Launch Pad and the general design of the UI. It's far too cluttered with not that useful information. If it's a Launch Pad, it should be able to directly send you to a whole selection of things.
- Move the notifications into the profile tab; move the profile tab to the top right of the launchpad while moving the "Hi, [username]" message over towards the new profile button.
- Combine the Safety tab with the Settings tab.
- Move the search tab to the top left of the launch pad, and have the quick search menu right next to it.
- The banner takes up too much space, along with the social/notification buttons next to it, so move and shrink the banner into the bottom left of the launchpad, and remove those extra buttons. Put a VRC+ advert next to the banner.
- Make columns for recent world. online friends, and avatars in place of the current rows.
- The help button can be placed where the "Hi, [username]" message is in-game, that way its more visible.
- The Safety, Notifications, Search, VRC+, and Help tabs can be removed from that list, as they are all on the launchpad. 
- When in a tab that isnt the launchpad, have the name of the tab espand into the list, moving the other tabs to make room as it expands 
Thankfully, that's the biggest changes on this list.
Worlds List:
Take the Variety Box and transform it into the main screen for every world category on the list, allowing you to see a list of worlds that fall under the selected category. Remove each of the "Featured World" tabs on the left-hand side, leaving everything that falls under "My Worlds" Remove the search bar, it's already on the top of the screen.
Avatars List: 
Remove the "Avatar Worlds" tabs at the bottom of the left-side list, as those are part of the Worlds menu. When a player doesn't have VRC+, grey out and minimize the subscription-accessed lists. Remove the "Legacy" tab (PC Only). Allow players to (directly) search avatar worlds here. 
Social Menu:
Remove the status changer and search bar, replace them with a incoming and outgoing Friend Requests. Group the favorite lists together into a column-based list for all 3, prioritizing online and joinable friends, then online but not joinable friends, and finally offline friends.
Profile Menu:
Remove the trust rank section, and color the background of each info box with the color of the trust rank. Move the languages into the vacant slot, put the Location section as a piece of text under the languages, and move the links to where the languages once were. Put the badges in the profile picture. Put a notification center where the links and badges used to be. This will house outgoing invites, join requests, and replies. The settings will hold the reply and invite settings. (While I'm on the topic of the world lists) Make the world lists a column-based list, spaced based on how many lists are allowed to be viewed.
title: Main Menu Redesign (Main Menu 3.0?)
